name: Additional Product Action Buttons (APAB)
author: pike136

sections.description:
Additional Product Action Buttons (APAB) is a free WooCommerce plugin that allows you to add extra action buttons to single product pages without editing your theme files.

The plugin is designed for stores that need alternative conversion actions such as contact requests, external links, or custom workflows instead of or in addition to the standard Add to Cart button.
